english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for moral, beneficial, favorable, pleasant, or broadly positive evaluations.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for something being excellent or wonderful.
This is the all-purpose choice for something pleasant or satisfactory, a generally good or decent person, or a favorable assessment.
Use 好 as the all-purpose choice for something generally pleasant, nice, or desirable.
For the approval sense, this is the all-purpose colloquial adjective meaning fine, good, or lovely.
Use this broad everyday choice when pleasant simply means nice or good in context.
Use this for a person or thing that is good, excellent, or admirable, especially for their character.
